obligations.expected_behavior: Bind every replay result to a complete Current Snapshot.
forbidden_result: A replay result is unbound from a Current Snapshot.
obligations.observable_result: The replay result records an association with a complete Current Snapshot.
obligations.state_after: The replay result is associated with a complete Current Snapshot.
obligations.state_before: A replay result is produced without an established complete Current Snapshot binding.
obligations.subject: Replay result snapshot binding
obligations.trigger: When a replay result is produced or recorded.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reproduce the replay result from a fresh checkout.
forbidden_result: Replay requires the original checkout state.
A fresh checkout cannot reproduce the replay result.
obligations.observable_result: Executing the replay from a fresh checkout reproduces the recorded result.
obligations.state_after: The recorded replay result is reproducible from a fresh checkout.
obligations.state_before: The replay result has not yet been reproduced from a fresh checkout.
obligations.subject: Fresh-checkout replay reproducibility
obligations.trigger: When replaying the result from a fresh checkout.

obligations.expected_behavior: When result-determining input drift is unexplained, classify the result as stale or fail closed.
forbidden_result: The result remains treated as current or valid despite unexplained result-determining input drift.
Replay proceeds as valid without stale classification or closed failure.
obligations.observable_result: The system either marks the result stale or terminates the replay through a fail-closed outcome.
obligations.state_after: The result is stale or the replay has failed closed.
obligations.state_before: Unexplained drift exists in an input that determines the result.
obligations.subject: Unexplained result-determining input drift
obligations.trigger: When unexplained drift is detected in a result-determining input.
